issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 03 asks for the names and types of all swimming pools along with the name and all population numbers of the associated municipalities (Gemeinde). The solution query in aufgabe03.sql selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name, which contradicts the required output (names of the pools). This mismatch between the problem requirement and the solution will confuse students about which column to output and cause automated checks to fail if they expect the name column.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query in aufgabe03.sql to select the swimming pool name column instead of the id. For example, replace Schwimmbad.id with Schwimmbad.name so the SELECT clause matches the problem statement (e.g. SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w ...). Alternatively, if the intent was to request ids, update the problem statement to ask for ids instead of names.

issues.description: The problem statement asks for the Namen (names) of Schwimmbäder, but the solution query selects Schwimmbad.id rather than Schwimmbad.name. This creates a mapping confusion: students expect to output the 'name' column as requested by the exercise, but the provided solution returns the 'id' column under the same conceptual entity (Schwimmbad).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the identifier with the problem requirement: in solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql replace Schwimmbad.id with Schwimmbad.name so the query returns the Schwimmbad names as requested. Also update the template aufgabe03.sql to include the same columns (Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art, ...) to make the mapping clear for students.
